action: Installation run completed. Check SSM Patch Compliance for installed/missing counts and reboot requirements.
Patch scan completed. A scan installs nothing; review compliance and schedule an installation if needed.
Invocation failed. Inspect stdout for this account, region, command_id and instance_id.
Execution started but timed out. Inspect instance load and the execution timeout.
Invocation stopped by the parent error threshold. Review the original failure and re-run the skipped invocation.
SSM could not deliver the command. Check agent and connectivity before re-running.
Command delivery expired. Check agent and connectivity before re-running.
Document does not support the target platform. Correct targeting.
SSM access to the target was denied. Check the initiating identity and target permissions.
The document succeeded but its Scan/Install operation is unavailable. Do not infer patch installation.
Cancelled before completion; execution may have started. Inspect invocation details before re-running.
Failure details are unavailable. Execution versus non-delivery is unresolved; inspect SSM.
Timeout details are unavailable. Delivery versus execution timeout is unresolved; inspect SSM.
Command summary only. Inspect the individual invocation outcomes.
Command exceeded the pending-invocation quota. Inspect command targets and account quotas.
No matching command targets. Check the target tag selection.
Insufficient execution details or a pipeline canary. Check record_type and the original event.
